title: Chapter 5: Usability and User Experience Evaluation
description: Covers HCI evaluation criteria and methods, including quantitative and qualitative usability, overall user experience (UX), interviews, cognitive walkthroughs, Nielsen's ten heuristics, measurement, and safety and ethics.

title: Chapter 6: Model-View-Controller (MVC) Pattern
description: Explores the Model-View-Controller design pattern in Human-Computer Interaction, explaining the roles of Model, View, and Controller, system data flow, software maintenance benefits, and practical analogies.
